title: Build with AI
shortDescription: Hands-on engineering sprint mastering Google Gemma, Agentic tool-use, and production RAG workflows.
description: Build with AI is an intensive multi-week initiative empowering builders across Central India to move beyond chat interfaces and build production-grade agentic architectures, custom fine-tuned open-weights models, and resilient retrieval systems powered by Google for Developers.

whyJoin.title: Production-Grade Engineering
whyJoin.description: Learn how to architect real-world LLMOps pipelines, function-calling agent swarms, and low-latency inference rather than relying on basic API prompts.

whyJoin.title: Direct Practitioner Mentorship
whyJoin.description: Receive 1-on-1 code reviews and architecture guidance from Google Developer Experts and senior AI engineers throughout your build sprint.

whyJoin.title: Ecosystem Cloud Compute
whyJoin.description: Get dedicated Google Cloud compute allocations and TPU hours to fine-tune and benchmark models without personal infrastructure barriers.

benefits.title: Google Cloud Credits
benefits.description: Compute allocations for model fine-tuning and hosting.

benefits.title: Exclusive Swag & Credentials
benefits.description: Verified completion certificates and limited-edition ML Bhopal builder swag kits.

benefits.title: Demo Day Stage at AI Day 2.0
benefits.description: Top projects receive speaking and showcase slots in front of 500+ attendees and hiring partners.

timeline.title: Sprint Kickoff & Gemma 2 Masterclass
timeline.description: Launch keynote and technical walkthrough of agentic tool-use with Google Gemma.

timeline.title: Architecture Reviews & Office Hours
timeline.description: Mid-sprint checkpoint with mentor feedback on vector databases and RAG metrics.

timeline.title: Project Submission & Code Freeze
timeline.description: Final GitHub repository submissions with demo videos and architecture diagrams.

timeline.title: Awards & Winner Showcase
timeline.description: Evaluation results and announcement of winning builder teams.

resources.title: Gemma 2 Fine-Tuning Cookbook
resources.description: Official ML Bhopal code template for LoRA and Unsloth fine-tuning.

resources.title: Production RAG Benchmark Notebook
resources.description: Step-by-step evaluation guide using Ragas and TruLens.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to participate?
faqs.answer: Any developer, student, or researcher located in Central India or participating in our online tracks. Solo builders and teams of up to 4 are welcome.

faqs.question: Is there any cost to register or participate?
faqs.answer: Zero cost. In alignment with ML Bhopal's open-access principles, all workshops, mentoring, and cloud credits are 100% free.

faqs.question: Can I submit an existing project?
faqs.answer: Projects must have significant progress and commits made during the challenge window. Forking an existing open-source repository without substantial added functionality is disqualified.

metadata.prerequisites: Python proficiency and basic understanding of LLMs

title: Gen AI Hackathon
shortDescription: 36-hour offline hackathon challenging builders to ship production-grade autonomous agent prototypes.
description: An in-person 36-hour hackathon bringing together 200+ engineers at a university campus in Bhopal to compete, build, and deploy applied artificial intelligence prototypes across enterprise automation, regional languages, and edge inference.

whyJoin.title: High-Intensity Environment
whyJoin.description: 36 uninterrupted hours of coding, hardware, and collaboration with the region's top developers.

whyJoin.title: Live Technical Jury
whyJoin.description: Pitch directly to technical CTOs, startup founders, and Google ecosystem mentors.

benefits.title: ₹1,00,000+ Prize Pool
benefits.description: Cash rewards for overall winners and specific track categories.

benefits.title: Direct Startup Hiring Pipeline
benefits.description: Fast-track interview opportunities with regional and national AI startups.

timeline.title: Registration Opens
timeline.description: Online team applications open on Commudle.

timeline.title: Shortlist Announcement
timeline.description: Top 50 teams invited to the offline physical venue.

faqs.question: Can I participate if I don't have a team yet?
faqs.answer: Yes. We host a dedicated team-formation mixer online before the event and in-person on morning of Day 1.

faqs.question: Is food and accommodation provided during the 36 hours?
faqs.answer: Yes. Meals, refreshments, internet, and resting zones are provided on-campus for all shortlisted teams.

title: TPU Learning Cohort
shortDescription: High-throughput tensor training masterclass utilizing Google Cloud TPU v5e pods and JAX.
description: A specialized 4-week research and engineering cohort exploring tensor parallelism, distributed data parallel training, and large-scale model sharding on dedicated Google Cloud TPU v5e pods.

whyJoin.title: Cutting-Edge TPU Hardware
whyJoin.description: Hands-on experience configuring and profiling tensor programs on Google TPU v5e pods.

whyJoin.title: JAX & Distributed Training
whyJoin.description: Learn modern sharding strategies, XLA compilation, and pipeline parallelism.

title: Kaggle Days Bhopal
shortDescription: Offline competitive machine learning sprint tackling tabular and multimodal challenges.
description: Central India's first dedicated Kaggle Days gathering, bringing together 150+ competitive data scientists to build, feature-engineer, and ensemble solutions under timed constraints.

whyJoin.title: Competitive Feature Engineering
whyJoin.description: Tackle real-world tabular data and optimize loss curves under strict time limits.
